messages:
emma: Quick follow-up from the postmortem this morning. We need clear owners and short timelines for the autoscale + GPU capacity items so this pattern doesn't repeat.

raj: I can take ownership of the scheduler tuning changes. Short plan: backoff preemptions, raise min idle per-node, and add a short debounce window.

sophie: I'll own alerting and runbooks. Alerts are too late today; we need a warning channel before capacity hits critical.

infra-bot: Created issues: GPU-1407 (headroom reserve pool), GPU-1408 (scheduler debounce/backoff), GPU-1409 (alerts + runbook), GPU-1410 (synthetic surge CI job).

chris: For GPU-1407 I'll prototype a 8% reserved headroom for premium and system workloads. Will include a rollback flag and per-tenant opt-out. Target 2026-04-08.

mike: Cost note: finance said temporary headroom is ok if we have an automatic rollback at cost delta >10%. I'll draft the guardrail.

raj: Scheduler bullets (draft):
```
- preempt_debounce: 6s
- min_idle_slots: 2 per GPU node
- preempt_backoff_multiplier: 1.5x
- local_affinity boost for low-latency queues
```
I'll open a PR with before/after metrics and a 6-hour canary plan.

sophie: Alerts: add warning at 78% committed GPUs, critical at 93%. Add Slack warning channel + oncall pager at critical. I'll attach a short runbook for mitigation steps.

chris: CI surge job (GPU-1410) plan: 20m spike with mixed seq lengths and KV cache warmup. Run nightly for two weeks post-change. Sophie, want me to hook the job into the alert dashboard?

sophie: Yes please, hook it to the alerting dashboard and surface regressions as PR comments.

emma: Owners + deadlines recap:
- GPU-1407 chris (headroom pool + opt-out) -> 2026-04-08
- GPU-1408 raj (scheduler debounce/backoff) -> 2026-03-30
- GPU-1409 sophie (alerts + runbook) -> 2026-03-28
- GPU-1410 chris (synthetic CI surge) -> 2026-03-27
- finance guardrails mike -> 2026-03-29

mike: I'll add cost guardrail language and a short approval flow for temporary headroom.

raj: I'll include a health-check gate that prevents global rollout if preemption rate increases >30% in the canary window.

emma: Schedule a 15-min catch-up next week to review metrics and decide on permanent changes. infra-bot, please create a recurring event.

infra-bot: Reminder: follow-up meeting scheduled 2026-03-26T14:00Z.

emma: Thanks all — I'll update the postmortem follow-ups doc and ping owners tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

sophie: ack.

chris: ack.

mike: ack.
